acceptance_criteria_reviewed.title: Hyperspace Jump Deducts Fuel and Moves Player
Hyperspace Jump Rejected When Insufficient Fuel

findings: AC-7 satisfied: performHyperspaceJump correctly deducts fuel (fuel_after = fuel_before - jump_cost) and moves player to destination system. JumpResult immutably returns new state. destinationSystemId cleared after jump. [src/travel.ts, tests/travel.test.ts]
AC-7 property fuel_non_negative satisfied: fuel >= 0 invariant enforced by the AC-8 guard (fuel < cost rejects before deduction). [src/travel.ts]
AC-7 property fuel_deduction monotonicity satisfied: tests assert exact formula fuel_after = fuel_before - cost with independently calculated cost. [tests/travel.test.ts]
AC-8 satisfied: jump rejected with 'Insufficient fuel' message when fuel < cost. Player remains in current system, fuel unchanged. [src/travel.ts, tests/travel.test.ts]
AC-8 property fuel_guard satisfied: test explicitly sets fuel = cost - 1 and verifies jump_succeeds = false. [tests/travel.test.ts]

Change scope respected: only src/game-state.ts (fuel field addition), src/travel.ts (new), tests/travel.test.ts (new) modified. No unrelated scope expansion. [src/game-state.ts, src/travel.ts, tests/travel.test.ts]
Test seam matches real call path: tests import directly from source modules and exercise the same function signatures used in production. [tests/travel.test.ts]
Single reviewable commit on task-scoped branch. Tree SHA and commit SHA match the implementation product. Base commit matches task graph integration target.
